summary: Backend RBAC + admin CRUD fully verified (10/10 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_admin.py). All qc_executive → admin-only endpoints return 403 (create/update product, add/update/delete checklist-item, add/update/delete ccp). include_inactive=1 is admin-only (qc gets active-only). Admin create product auto-creates a v1 active checklist template; items of every param type (numeric with min/max, passfail, yesno, dropdown w/ options, text) persist and reflect in GET /products/{id}/checklist. Add/edit/delete CCP with critical limits persists correctly. Duplicate product_code returns 409. Missing item/ccp updates+deletes return 404. Frontend admin UI: qc@qc.com does NOT see ADMIN section on dashboard ✓. admin@qc.com sees ADMIN → Manage Products; Manage Products lists all products (including INACTIVE) with EDIT + CHECKLIST + ADD PRODUCT buttons; Add Product form creates the product and lands back in the list; Checklist Builder opens; CCP modal adds a CCP successfully (verified in-list + toast). ISSUE FOUND: tapping 'Manage Products' from dashboard navigates to /products (Select Product for inspection) instead of /admin/products because the sticky bottom CTA 'START NEW INSPECTION' (position:absolute) overlaps the ADMIN action row — the tap goes to the CTA underneath. Direct navigation to /admin/products works and every downstream screen works. Also minor: on 390x844, the parameter/CCP modal content can extend below the visible area; save button requires an in-modal scroll to reach on some devices.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Manage Products' navigates to /products instead of /admin/products because the sticky bottom CTA bar (Start New Inspection, position: absolute) overlaps the ADMIN action row after scroll. Repro: login as admin → scroll down to ADMIN section → tap 'Manage Products'. Fix: add extra bottom padding to the ScrollView contentContainerStyle (currently 140 is not enough with ADMIN section), OR move ADMIN section above QUICK ACTIONS, OR position the CTA below the scroll (non-absolute). Reference: /app/frontend/app/dashboard.tsx:96 (paddingBottom: 140) and :237 (ctaBar absolute).

issues: On 390x844, modal contents (param chips + section + unit + min/max + sequence + toggles + save) require scrolling inside the modal to reach the save button. Modal uses KeyboardAwareScrollView so scrolling works, but the save button is often below the fold. Consider a sticky bottom save button inside the modal, or shorten default content.

rca_of_issue: Dashboard 'Manage Products' tap → wrong route (/products). Reproduction: login admin@qc.com/Admin@12345 → scroll to ADMIN section → tap 'Manage Products'. Observed navigation goes to /products (Select Product screen). Root cause: /app/frontend/app/dashboard.tsx renders a sticky bottom CTA bar (styles.ctaBar with position:'absolute', bottom:0) containing 'START NEW INSPECTION' which routes to /products. The ScrollView content padding-bottom (140) is not enough once the ADMIN section is added, so admin actions can sit UNDER the CTA. force-clicking the admin row therefore lands on the CTA below it. Fix: (a) increase paddingBottom to ~220 so admin row can clear the CTA, or (b) reorder to put ADMIN section BEFORE QUICK ACTIONS, or (c) render the CTA inside the scroll view (non-absolute).
